caption: The drawing depicts a circular bowl with a thick rim, shaded in tones of gray to emphasize depth and curvature. Attached to the upper edge of the bowl is a decorative, symmetrical handle featuring three heart-shaped cutouts and additional circular forms, also rendered in gray tones for shading. The drawing is done on an off-white paper background, with a rectangular border surrounding the main subject. In the upper left corner, there is a small inset drawing showing a simple side-profile outline of the bowl, also done in gray lines. The artist's signature, "H. MARAJIAN," appears in the lower right corner. There is a faint brownish stain on the left side of the paper near the edge.
title: Pewter Porringer
